name: VS Code extension with security-related marketplace removal was activated
description: Parsed VS Code extension-host telemetry reports activation of an extension whose identifier appears in Microsoft VS Marketplace removal history with a security-related reason. Review the activation record and subsequent errors; this is not proof that activation completed successfully or that malicious code ran.
false_positives: The feed identifies extensions without affected version ranges. Review the removal reason, installed version, and current publisher status; a matching identifier alone does not establish malicious behavior.
note: Review the source host, user profile, extension identifier and version. Read the Microsoft removal reason in threat.enrichments.indicator.description and follow threat.enrichments.indicator.reference. These rules cover recent ingested telemetry and inventory snapshots; they do not scan 30 days of historical activations. Events missing event.ingested are excluded. Alert suppression applies separately to each rule. Closing an alert may reset suppression under the default Elastic setting.
